title: Comments
description: DataViews comment moderation: approve / spam / trash via partial saveEntityRecord.

variant.description: Optional DataView variant id (e.g. 'pending'). v2 back-compat: when the v3 compiler synthesizes a screen from a v2 route, `config.variant` stays on `screen.config.variant` and the resolver's step-3 manifest-inference path reads it directly to reach `settings.dataViews.root.comment.<variant>`.

documentation.purpose: DataViews-driven comment moderation list. The author cell stacks avatar + name + email (`mailto:`) + author URL link + author IP (moderators only); content renders as HTML; status + date follow. A `ViewTabs` strip above the list mirrors the classic All / Pending / Approved / Spam / Trash status views with live per-status counts. Bulk + per-row status actions: approve, unapprove, mark as spam, not spam (unspam), restore (untrash), move to trash, delete permanently. Status changes round-trip via partial `saveEntityRecord` PATCH; trash routes through `deleteEntityRecord` (no `force`), permanent delete through `deleteEntityRecord(..., { force: true })`. Per-row Edit (Quick Edit ≡ full Edit collapsed into one `createEntityFormModal` edit-mode modal) and Reply (`createEntityFormModal` create-mode, content-only POST with row-derived `parent`/`post`) substitute for the upstream-blocked inline-cell / detail-row primitives.

reads.purpose: Resolved DataView doc — fields, default view, default layouts, actions. Read via `useDataView(screenId)`; baseline ships in `app.json#dataView` (with variants family) and is injected post-merge by `inject_app_baselines`.
Per-status totals for the status filter elements ("Approved (12)"). One lightweight request per status value via `useEntityElementCounts`; the total comes from the X-WP-Total header.

writes.purpose: Approve / unapprove / spam / unspam / untrash — PATCH `{ id, status }`. `unspam` and `untrash` both target `approved`.
Modal Edit — PATCH `author_name` / `author_email` (moderators only) / `author_url` / `content` / `status` / `date` via `useEntityRecord().save()` on the buffered record.
Reply — POST `{ content, parent, post }` where `parent`/`post` come from the subject row; author defaults to the current moderator server-side and the reply auto-approves.
Delete permanently — `deleteEntityRecord('root','comment', id, { force: true })`. Confirmed via destructive `createBulkConfirmModal`.

states.renders: Table with action chips per row.
DataViews empty state for the current filter.

states.when: User triggered Trash or Delete permanently action

states.renders: `createEntityFormModal` edit-mode form (author_name / author_email / author_url / content / status / date).
`createEntityFormModal` create-mode form — content textarea above the read-only parent-comment context.

interactions.trigger: Click a view tab (All / Pending / Approved / Spam / Trash)
interactions.effect: Writes the segment's `status` filter into `view.filters` (or clears it for All) and resets to page 1; counts come from `useEntityElementCounts`.
Open the edit modal; on save PATCH the buffered record (full field set); invalidate list + counts; success snackbar.
Open the reply modal; on submit POST `{ content, parent: item.id, post: item.post }`; invalidate list + counts; success snackbar.
Open confirm modal; on confirm `deleteEntityRecord` (trash, no `force`) per item; invalidate; success snackbar.
Open destructive confirm modal; on confirm `deleteEntityRecord(..., { force: true })` per item; invalidate; success snackbar.
Local `view` updates; queryArgs recomputes; records refetch.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews owns focus inside the table + action modal.

constraints.note: Status changes are sent as `saveEntityRecord('root', 'comment', { id, status })` — a partial payload that PATCHes only the status. Sending the full record would clobber any concurrent edit.

Comment content is rendered HTML — WordPress core sanitizes via `wp_filter_comment_content` (kses + comment-text filter chain) server-side before it reaches the REST response, so the value is trust-bounded. Plain text would lose the formatted view moderators rely on.
REST orderby alias for date is `date_gmt`, not `date`. Sorting by `date` column passes `date_gmt` to the API.

Every action invalidates `getEntityRecords` on `root/comment` AND the per-status `useEntityElementCounts` queries (via `invalidateEntityElementCounts`) so the list, status filter labels, and view tabs all reflect the new state.

The author IP is rendered only when `userCan('moderate_comments')` (resolved once at module load from the static cap map). The app cap floor is already `moderate_comments`, so the gate is belt-and-suspenders for a future relaxed floor + matches the wp-admin behavior where IP is moderator-only.

Reply (`createEntityFormModal` create mode) derives `parent` + `post` from the subject row inside `toRecord(draft, item)` — they are never user-editable fields. The shared factory threads the action's subject row into `toData`/`toRecord`/`renderContext` so this inline-creation pattern needs no comments-only modal.

design-system-leakage.purpose: DataViews + DataForm components, field descriptor shape. Table view + per-row actions + Edit/Reply form modals.
Author cell, view-tab strip, modal layout, cancel button.
Destructive primary in trash confirm modal — WPDS 0.12 has no `tone="critical"`.
